meta.title: Yoyo Travel — Explore More. Collect Memories.
meta.description: Discover provinces and places across Thailand, randomize trips, and keep your personal travel passport.

auth.demoBanner: Demo mode: sign-in is not configured yet. Your travel records are stored in this browser only.
auth.signInToSave: Sign in to save your travel records
auth.loginBody: Sign in to sync trips, your wishlist and passport across devices
auth.notConfiguredBody: This site has not configured Supabase yet, so sign-up and sign-in are unavailable. Everything works as a guest; your data stays in this browser.
auth.privacyNote: We never see or store your password; Supabase Auth stores it one-way hashed. Your trips are visible only to you.
auth.guestBanner: You're browsing as a guest. Trips and lists are saved in this browser only and are not synced to an account.
auth.guestNotSynced: Saved in this browser, not synced to an account
auth.storageUnavailable: This browser does not allow saving data (e.g. private mode or blocked cookies). What you save will be lost when you close the page. Sign in to save permanently.
auth.importTitle: We found data you saved as a guest
auth.importBody: {trips} trips · {wishlist} wishlist · {visits} visited places · {provinces} province states — import into your account without creating duplicates
auth.importFailed: Import failed. Your guest data is still in this browser; you can try again.
auth.syncFailed: Could not save to your account ({count} pending). Your changes are still on this page.
auth.registerBody: Keep trips and travel records in your account. Your data is private by default.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your username or email and we'll send a reset link to the account's email.
auth.usernameRules: 3–20 characters: lowercase a-z, digits and _ only
auth.usernamePick: No username yet — pick one here (3–20 chars: a-z, 0-9, _)
auth.emailWhy: Used to verify your identity and recover your account. Never shown to others.
auth.passwordRules: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers
auth.termsNote: By signing up you agree to data handling as described in our
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent you a confirmation link. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.
auth.resetSent: If an account matches, we've sent a password reset link to its email.
auth.deleteAccountBody: Permanently delete your account and all personal data (trips, wishlist, passport, notes). This cannot be undone.

home.heroTitle: Explore more. Collect memories in every province.
home.heroSubtitle: Discover all 77 provinces on a real map, randomize trips from real records, and keep your travel passport.
home.mapSubtitle: Tap a province for details. Colours show your travel status.
home.popularTitle: Provinces with the most places in our data
home.popularBasis: Sorted by number of places in our dataset (not visitor statistics)
home.curatedTitle: Places with the most Wikipedia articles
home.curatedBasis: Sorted by how many Wikipedia language editions cover the place (Wikidata sitelinks) — a rough measure of international recognition, not reviews or current popularity
home.foodBasis: Venue data from OpenStreetMap. No verified menus, prices or review scores yet.
home.dataNote: Place coverage is not exhaustive and grows from permitted sources.

top.title: Top 10 & picks
top.subtitle: Every ranking states its basis and data source
top.provinces: Top 10 provinces by attractions in our data
top.provincesBasis: Count of attractions (excluding restaurants and stays) in our dataset — reflects data coverage, not visitor numbers
top.attractionsBasis: Number of Wikipedia language editions with an article about the place (Wikidata sitelinks) — a proxy for international recognition, not review scores
top.freeBasis: Places tagged fee=no in OpenStreetMap — please confirm with the venue
top.seasonalBasis: Based on Thailand's general climate patterns (Thai Meteorological Department), not a forecast
top.perProvinceHint: Choose a province to see its 10 places with the most Wikipedia coverage
top.restaurantsNone: No verified ratings or reviews yet, so restaurants, cafes and stays are not ranked.
top.trendingNone: Not enough recent usage data yet, so no “Trending Now” list is shown.
top.timeNote: “This week / this month” filters will be enabled once time-based data exists.
top.familyBasis: Parks, zoos, museums and activities, sorted by Wikipedia coverage
top.couplesBasis: Beaches, islands, viewpoints and mountains, sorted by Wikipedia coverage

seasons.tipCool: Pleasant weather in the north and northeast — great for mountains, viewpoints and national parks.
seasons.tipHot: Seas on both the Gulf and Andaman coasts are mostly calm — good for beaches and islands.
seasons.tipRainy: Waterfalls and forests are lush, but the Andaman coast is rough during the southwest monsoon — check boat notices.
seasons.tipGulfSouth: The lower Gulf coast usually gets heavy rain around Oct–Dec.
seasons.gulf: Lower Gulf coast: generally best Jan–Sep
seasons.general: The most comfortable weather nationwide is roughly Nov–Feb
seasons.source: Source: general climate of Thailand, Thai Meteorological Department

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Province or place name (Thai or English)
search.nearMeAsk: Allow location access to find nearby places. Your location is not stored.
